title.ko: 개인정보 자동 수집 장치의 설치·운영 및 거부에 관한 사항

rules.statement: When cookies or similar technologies are installed on own web/app, explain the concept, purpose of use, how data is collected, and how to refuse, plus the personal data processed through them.
Give concrete refusal steps for the web browsers and mobile environments actually used (see appendices for current browser steps).

If behavioral data is processed identifying the data subject, state: legal basis, items, collection method, purpose, retention, and refusal method; if provided to third parties: legal basis, recipient, items, recipient's purpose and retention.

check.expr: if(slot(gate.behavioralIdentified)) every(section.S14.behavioral.identified, r => r.legalBasis && r.items && r.method && r.purpose && r.retention && r.optOut)

rules.statement: Identified behavioral processing may be written in S03/S07 (marked as behavioral data), but the collection method and refusal method via devices must still appear here.

If behavioral data is processed for targeted ads without identifying the subject, say so and state items, method, purpose, retention, refusal; for provision: recipient, items, recipient's purpose and retention.
When both identified and non-identified processing occur (e.g. members vs non-members), describe both.
If own devices placed on third-party web/apps collect behavioral data identifying individuals, disclose it; where those sites change often, the site type may be given.

goodPatterns: Blocks: installed devices (cookie explanation and refusal steps) → behavioral data collection table → provision to ad partners table → collection via tools on other sites (with site-list link) → minimal, non-sensitive behavioral data statement → children and targeted ads statement → browser and ad-ID opt-out steps → contact for questions and objections.
Ad-ID opt-out: Android and iOS steps with a note that menus vary by OS version.

commonDefects.defect: Cookie section says only 'you can refuse cookies' without steps or purposes.
Identified behavioral profiling for ads without legal basis or retention.
App uses ad IDs but only browser cookie steps are given.

extractionHints: cookie, pixel, tag, SDK, ADID/IDFA, analytics tool names
references: PIPC policy on online behavioral data for targeted ads (2024.1), cited at L2244

needsVerification.note: Browser menu paths change frequently; the drafter must take steps from a maintained clause, not from this pack. The legal basis for identified behavioral data (consent in the examples) is example-level only.
